title: All-errors fixture misses collect's branch-fallback report read; everyHerdrMethod omits pane.close
body: Injecting e.client.AgentGet into readReport's branch fallback (internal/exec/herdr/inspect.go:326, reached when both the worktree copy and the archive are gone) passes every test in internal/exec/herdr; TestCollectReadsTheReportFromTheBranchWhenTheWorktreeIsGone drives that path but never counts calls. That is the same shape as 3kx, one read further on. Separately, everyHerdrMethod (evidence_test.go:49) claims to be every wire method but lacks pane.close (added by rj0), so the 'all-errors' fixture answers pane.close with success; derive the list from the pinned wire vocabulary so it cannot drift.
